method: Read-only official release-get and trace-list/get; three paired requests from one published window. Raw traces remain private.
interpretation: All six complete traces record data spans without overlap. This does not prove that the database driver cannot overlap queries generally.
The live catalogue path is EngineeringIssueSearchService.catalogue, which authorizes full exact saved work per entry; EngineeringMatterDirectoryService.list is a different endpoint.

Controlled Promise overlap alone is not evidence of deployed latency improvement. Reducing independent post-authorization SQL round trips is the next candidate; preserve fresh per-member access, tenant/source identity, version checks, and error precedence.
limits: Three request pairs are not p95 or a controlled background-load comparison.
Trace spans do not explain every interval between SQL operations or isolate network, CPU, and platform scheduling.
No product code changed in this evidence batch.
